entities.summary: The government of Syria takes place in a unitary presidential system and is, as of 2026, in a provisional period led by a transitional government in most of the country. The current President of Syria is Ahmed al-Sharaa. The seat of the central government is located in Damascus, while the Democratic Autonomous Administration of North and East Syria governs small exclaves in the north and east regions.
